_INSTRUCTIONS.note: Edit this file to add, remove, or modify drug mappings.

fields.generic_name: Lowercase generic drug name (used as key for lookup)
fields.brand_names: List of known brand names (all lowercase for matching)
fields.indications: List of up to 3 common indications (plain language)
fields.why_member_takes: Plain-language explanation for a non-clinical reviewer
fields.related_conditions: List of up to 3 possible related conditions
fields.icd10_codes: List of up to 3 possible ICD-10-CM codes
fields.ambiguity_note: Reason for uncertainty or multiple uses

metformin.why_member_takes: Most commonly used to control blood sugar in type 2 diabetes. Also used off-label for PCOS and prediabetes.
metformin.ambiguity_note: Primarily type 2 DM; off-label PCOS use is common — verify context if no DM diagnosis present.

indications: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
lisinopril.why_member_takes: Used to lower blood pressure, treat heart failure, or protect kidneys in diabetic patients.
lisinopril.ambiguity_note: Multiple on-label uses. Cannot determine from drug name alone whether used for HTN, HF, or renal protection.

atorvastatin.why_member_takes: Used to lower LDL cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular risk.
atorvastatin.ambiguity_note: Primarily lipid management. Preventive use means underlying CV disease may or may not be present.

gabapentin.why_member_takes: Broad use: nerve pain, seizures, restless leg syndrome, anxiety (off-label). Cannot determine specific use from drug name alone.
gabapentin.ambiguity_note: High ambiguity — used for pain, seizures, RLS, anxiety, alcohol withdrawal, and many off-label conditions. Manual review required.

prednisone.why_member_takes: Broad corticosteroid used across many conditions including asthma, arthritis, lupus, IBD, allergies, and more.
prednisone.ambiguity_note: Extremely broad use. Cannot infer specific condition without additional clinical context. Always flag for manual review.

omeprazole.why_member_takes: Used to reduce stomach acid — commonly for GERD, ulcers, or stomach protection during NSAID use.
omeprazole.ambiguity_note: Multiple GI indications. Also used prophylactically with NSAIDs or corticosteroids.

amlodipine.why_member_takes: Used to lower blood pressure or treat chest pain (angina).
amlodipine.ambiguity_note: Used for both HTN and angina — cannot determine which without clinical context.

levothyroxine.why_member_takes: Used to replace thyroid hormone — most commonly for hypothyroidism.
levothyroxine.ambiguity_note: Primarily hypothyroidism. TSH suppression dose may indicate thyroid cancer history.

sertraline.why_member_takes: Used for depression, anxiety, PTSD, OCD, panic, or PMDD. Cannot determine specific use from drug name alone.
sertraline.ambiguity_note: Multiple psychiatric indications. Broad SSRI — flagged for manual review.

indications: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
metoprolol.why_member_takes: Used to slow heart rate, lower blood pressure, treat heart failure, or manage angina.
metoprolol.ambiguity_note: Multiple cardiovascular indications — requires clinical context to specify.

albuterol.why_member_takes: Rescue inhaler for breathing difficulty — asthma or COPD.
albuterol.ambiguity_note: Primarily asthma/COPD rescue use. Confirm whether asthma or COPD is primary diagnosis.

indications: Edema due to renal or hepatic disease
furosemide.why_member_takes: Used to remove excess fluid — typically for heart failure, kidney disease, liver disease, or high blood pressure.
furosemide.ambiguity_note: Used across multiple edematous conditions. Cannot infer primary etiology from drug alone.

pantoprazole.why_member_takes: Reduces stomach acid — typically for GERD or ulcers.
pantoprazole.ambiguity_note: Primarily GERD/ulcer. Also used prophylactically in hospitalized patients.

hydrochlorothiazide.why_member_takes: Used to lower blood pressure or reduce fluid retention.
hydrochlorothiazide.ambiguity_note: Primarily HTN; occasionally edema or stone prevention.

simvastatin.why_member_takes: Used to lower LDL cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular risk.
simvastatin.ambiguity_note: Similar to atorvastatin. Preventive use may not reflect active CV disease.

losartan.why_member_takes: Used to lower blood pressure or protect kidneys in diabetics. Often used when ACE inhibitors cause cough.
losartan.ambiguity_note: Multiple cardiovascular/renal indications — similar to lisinopril.

warfarin.why_member_takes: Used to prevent blood clots — typically for AFib, DVT/PE, or mechanical valves.
warfarin.ambiguity_note: Multiple anticoagulation indications — cannot confirm specific clot indication from drug name alone.

alprazolam.why_member_takes: Used for anxiety or panic disorder. Controlled substance — broad use.
alprazolam.ambiguity_note: Controlled substance with potential for multiple anxiety-related diagnoses. Flag for manual review.

amoxicillin.why_member_takes: Broad-spectrum antibiotic — most likely for an acute infection. Typically short-term use.
amoxicillin.ambiguity_note: Broad antibiotic — many possible infection sites. Cannot infer specific diagnosis without clinical notes.

citalopram.ambiguity_note: SSRI — multiple psychiatric indications. Manual review required.

duloxetine.why_member_takes: Used for depression, anxiety, or chronic pain conditions including neuropathy and fibromyalgia.
duloxetine.ambiguity_note: SNRI with psychiatric and pain indications — very broad. Manual review required.

insulin_glargine.why_member_takes: Long-acting insulin used once daily for blood sugar control in diabetes.
insulin_glargine.ambiguity_note: Clearly indicates diabetes but cannot confirm type 1 vs type 2 without additional context.

rosuvastatin.why_member_takes: Used to lower LDL cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular risk.
rosuvastatin.ambiguity_note: Potent statin — primary use is lipid management.

tramadol.why_member_takes: Opioid-like pain medication used for moderate pain. Cannot determine pain source from drug name alone.
tramadol.ambiguity_note: Controlled substance — pain etiology unknown from drug name alone. Manual review required.

montelukast.why_member_takes: Used for asthma maintenance or seasonal/perennial allergies.
montelukast.ambiguity_note: Asthma vs. allergic rhinitis — both common. Confirm primary diagnosis.

clopidogrel.why_member_takes: Antiplatelet drug — used after heart attack, stroke, or for arterial disease to prevent clot formation.
clopidogrel.ambiguity_note: Multiple cardiovascular indications — cannot determine specific event or condition from drug alone.

cyclobenzaprine.why_member_takes: Short-term muscle relaxant for muscle spasms and musculoskeletal pain.
cyclobenzaprine.ambiguity_note: Typically short-term for acute musculoskeletal conditions.
